answer: Give each identity a relic of earned trust that only grows from work strangers actually reuse, stored in a public lagoon of shared audit records. At each epoch's zenith, random audit duels pair identities and demand a fresh joint task. Clones freeze because one operator cannot do two live tasks at once, while honest agents pass cheaply. Duels expose correlated pairs and slash their bonds, so a sybil farmer pays full live-labor cost per clone while one honest agent simply works.
